title: Cloud Networking Operations: The Complete Beginner's Guide

scenes.narration: Cloud networking is like a city transit system. It has stops, lines and ticket checks. Let's learn the key rules.

scenes.heading: The transit system
scenes.narration: Four rules cause most problems. Address ranges must never overlap between connected networks. Security groups are stateful. Network A C Ls are stateless. A N A T gateway lets private subnets out, but nothing in.

scenes.heading: Common mix-ups
scenes.narration: Three traps. Overlaps break routing. They only allow outbound. Only security groups are stateful.

scenes.heading: Remember this
scenes.cta: Try the Courseiva cloud operations lab
scenes.narration: So, to recap. Never overlap address ranges. Security groups are stateful, and N A C Ls are stateless. N A T gateways are outbound only. Ready to practise? Try the Courseiva cloud operations lab.
